help.title: Help & Support
help.intro: Find quick answers below or contact the NTS team.

faqs.q: How do I add a module?
faqs.a: Admins open Admin Panel > Courses & Modules > Add Module, fill in the details and upload the cover image, intro video and learning files straight from the computer.

faqs.q: How do I get my certificate?
faqs.a: Finish all lessons, pass the quiz, then open Certificates and request your certificate. Your trainer or the admin approves it and you can download it as PDF.
Use Forgot password on the login page, or open Profile > Update Password when you are logged in.

faqs.q: How do parents see their child's results?
faqs.a: Parents see marks, attendance and certificates once the trainer or the admin shares them from the Attendance and Certificates pages.
